title: LIVE SOLAR RADIATION
source_name: NOAA/NCEP GFS operational surface analysis, DSWRF (downward short-wave radiation flux), 6-hourly cycles (00/06/12/18Z)
variable: DSWRF surface f000 analysis step (newest available GFS cycle)
temporal: f000 analysis-step flux of the newest available GFS cycle (not instantaneous, not daily accumulation)
what: Surface downward shortwave solar radiation flux: solar power arriving at the surface, GFS f000 analysis step for the newest available cycle. Nighttime reads zero (valid data, deep blue) — not missing data. Clouds reduce values quantitatively versus clear sky.
why_extreme: Rare peak midday clear-sky values compress into red-violet/deep-purple; ordinary day/night conditions own most of the color resolution.
